Many companies talk about Supply Chain maturity, but few have mapped every step required for true transformation. Progress isn’t about gut feel, it’s about continuous assessment across every domain, with practical, meas…
Here’s my go-to reference, a grid (roadmap) that Supply Chain professionals can use to benchmark and drive improvement:
1️⃣ Strategy 🚩Is your strategy documented 🚩Aligned to business goals 🚩 Fully cascaded 🚩Are KPIs reviewed, 🚩Leadership engaged, 🚩Is CI in Supply Chain DNA
2️⃣ SC Planning 🚩Demand and supply plans sync 🚩Is forecast accuracy measured / used 🚩Is production planning data-driven 🚩Contingency planning in place

3️⃣ Sourcing 🚩Are supplier selection standardized Regular supplier performance reviews 🚩How strong is risk management, 🚩Strategic partnerships and audits routine driving improvement not just compliance
